This '''strike team''' was handpicked by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to track [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], and hunt down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

==History==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], including [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]], sensed a great presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Tribe learned from Ship that the presence belonged to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and, realizing that this Jedi stood between them and their proposed reconquest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the name of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], Rhea and [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] decided to assemble a team to hunt down and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skywalker. [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] that had helped the Tribe to create a [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|new armada]], abruptly left [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], however, and the team's objective was changed to recovering the Sith Meditation Sphere, with killing Skywalker coming second.

===Finding Ship===
The strike team tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where they met with a woman named [[Abeloth]]. Abeloth claimed to have been stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for the last three decades, but in reality she was a powerful being who had gained control of both Ship and the planet she resided on. After nearly drowning, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] was told Abeloth's true nature by Ship, but when she told the other members of the team, they didn't believe her. Meanwhile, Abeloth used the flora and fauna of the planet to kill many of the Sith. After she discovered that Skywalker was [[beyond shadows]] in the Maw with his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], Abeloth allowed them to leave, under the condition that they captured the Skywalkers, rather than kill them. Rhea, however, did not believe that Vol would approve of this, and changed the objective back to kill.

===Attacking the Skywalkers===
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Vestara Khai, sole survivor of the strike team]]
The Sith found the Grand Master and his son on [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw that was the home of the [[Mind Walkers]]. The team [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] the Skywalkers, but the Jedi fought them off and escaped farther into the station, covering their retreat with [[azetal]] gas. Meanwhile, [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]], his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Ahri Raas]], Rhea's apprentice [[Vestara Khai]], and [[Sith Saber]] [[Baad Walusari]] planned to ambush the Jedi with [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]] at a junction in the Station. Xal, however, planned to take control of the strike team, and when the Jedi arrived on the scene, he and his apprentice attempted to kill Khai and Walusari by throwing their own grenades back at them. Rhea had expected such a move, however, and had ordered Khai and Walusari to first throw fake grenades. Angered by the betrayal, Vestara killed Xal, and Raas, distracted by his Master's cry of pain and surprise, was killed by one of the Skywalkers. The Jedi then killed Walusari and Luke allowed Khai to strike him with her [[Parang/Legends|parang]] in order to establish a [[Blood trail]] on her. He then knocked her out and took her hostage.

As the Jedi made their way toward the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in an attempt to get to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], however, they were ambushed by more Sith. During the ensuing skirmish Khai reawakened and managed to escape from them, but they defeated the remaining Sith and escaped to the hangar, where Ben prepared their ship for takeoff. Meanwhile, Luke reentered the Station, where he confronted the last four survivng members of the strike team. The two surviving [[Gender/Legends|males]] were quickly killed, leaving just Rhea and Khai alive. They [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] with him in the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] leading to the hangar. Meanwhile, Ben opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on Ship, distracting the two Sith, and allowing Luke to kill Rhea. Khai, the last survivng member of the team, saluted Skywalker and fled. She traveled to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], with the Skywalkers tracking her using the Blood trail.

==Organization==
The strike team was led by Circle of Lords member Lady Olaris Rhea, who commanded the ''[[Eternal Crusader]]''. Sith Master Yuvar Xal served as the second-in-command as her [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]], although she left the ship under the command of Walusari during the search for Ship on Abeloth's planet, as she trusted the Sith Saber more than Xal.
